text:
I checked the dictate-plugins proposal and sent the rewrites to its owner, `mastermind-dictate-plugins`, which is still working. It failed on length, not on the text-check script, which found no flags. I didn't open any page or screenshot, since a `requirements.md` is a brief for agents and has no rendered page.

- **Title:** the H1 is about 35 words and carries the whole role aside. I sent a short one, "Voice Chat: every feature a plugin you can switch on and off", and moved the aside into the Do section.
- **Long paragraphs:** line 3 (about 70 words) and line 5 (about 90 words) are over the 60-word limit. I sent the split into short bullets, with the Voice Chat name and its "voice session" alternative as separate lines.
- **Links:** I asked that each candidate plugin's module (Dictate, Recite) be linked where it exists.

I logged one `sent` line in `.claude/skills/clarity/flags.jsonl`.

The census proposal passes the clarity check, so I made no changes. `node Server/text-check.mjs` returned no flags. The title says what the census is, the deliverable format is one line per feature, and the file is short. I logged one "clear" line in `flags.jsonl`.

I wrote `census.jsonl` in the census folder: 21 features, then the two summary lines. I logged the two counts as a `log` line in `session.jsonl` (that folder has no `task.jsonl`). Nothing is committed.

**The counts:** I counted 29 settings: 23 wired, 6 partly wired, 0 unwired.
- **Wired (23):**
  - All 19 `SETTINGS` keys in `ext/Chat/Mic.js`, each read in code.
  - Four Recite values saved in `localStorage` (auto-read, barge-in on/off, threshold, voice).
- **Partly wired (6):** these change behaviour but have no panel row and aren't saved.
  - `thinking_cue`
  - `cue_repeat_ms`
  - `turn_wait_ms`
  - `update_hold_ms`
  - `BargeIn.quiet_ms`
  - Servex `answer_quiet_ms` (environment variable only)

**No setting at all:** these features can't be switched off today. Each row in the file has the grep proof.
- Word highlight
- Tap to pause
- Per-bubble replay
- The two send cursors
- Whisper repeat collapse

**Barge-in:** it has no `words` option anywhere in the code.

**Lifting out:** the send delay, safety chunks, clean-up, send mode and no-flood sit inside the send state machine or share state in `Recite.js`. Those are tangled. The highlight, tap, replay, cursors, repeat collapse, wake knobs and filler words are clean to lift out.
Test suite is running in the background; I'll log progress meanwhile.
